ABOUT MUVESIC

Movement becomes music.

A little guidance.
A world of sound to explore.

Muvesic is a musical playground you control with your hands or your whole body. Use your webcam, or try a mouse, touch, or keyboard. Start with these three simple movements.

01 / PITCH

Reach for the high notes.

Your fingertip moves through a scale. Higher hand, higher note.

02 / SPACE

Let the sound wander.

Move left and right to shift the sound between your ears. Try headphones.

03 / FEEL

Put a little energy into it.

Move gently for softer notes. Sweep faster to give your melody more feeling.

Three performance modes: two-hand solo with one sound per hand, orchestra where one hand conducts a four-section ensemble, and move your body where each limb becomes its own voice on one shared instrument. In solo and orchestra, close your fist to silence the active voice without leaving the session.
